content: Winter 1092
Border Battlefield, Kazdel

speaker: Injured Soldier

content: That's not what we need to worry about.

speaker: Ulšulah
content: This is why I hate mercenaries.

speaker: Injured Soldier
content: Another coincidence...

speaker: Ulšulah
content: It's not a coincidence if it keeps happening over and over again. We've had way too many setbacks lately.

speaker: Ulšulah
content: Focus, Babel forces must be—

speaker: Injured Soldier
content: Wait, hel—

content: A flash of white, and a hole appears in the soldier's forehead. They cannot even tell where the attack is coming from, in the noise of the cystybeast stampede.

text: 'Leave the supplies behind, and you may leave unharmed. You have been warned.'

speaker: Ulšulah
content: Hmph... just a bluff! Keep your head low and stay with me!

speaker: Ulšulah

speaker: Ulšulah

text: 'Be patient and follow the Doctor's instructions. The Chairman has said that the priority is to minimize casualties.'

content: I know, Mantra.

content: Mantra's lips are closed, but Scout can hear her voice clearly in his head.

content: She is the perfect coordinator for Babel's covert operations, and a shadow that eats away at the enemy's sanity.

content: The enemy vanguard has been scattered by the herd. The survivors have fled into the woods.

speaker: Mantra
content: The enemy's actions were spontaneous, unplanned. They must have known that we decrypted their communications. But the envelopment succeeded nonetheless.

speaker: Mantra
content: We can leave the rest to Ascalon.

speaker: Scout
content: Ascalon will not fail.

content: Neither will we.

speaker: Scout
content: Hah, you're absolutely right. You should get some rest, Mantra. 'Talking' takes a toll on you.

speaker: Dying Mercenary
content: Who directed this operation... the evil spirit again? Just what is this commander? Which Royal Court does it come from?

speaker: Dying Mercenary
content: If it can do this to us, it can do it to you too! Why would you sell your soul to something like that?!

speaker: Ascalon

content: Be more decisive next time, Odda, and there'll be fewer injuries.

speaker: Odda
content: The entire squad is dead... they should have died an honorable death, not tormented by fear—

content: This is not the right time to show mercy. Bring Marcel. Our mission is finished.

speaker: Odda
content: You... you remember his name?

speaker: Ascalon
content: I remember everyone in Babel, the living and the dead, the ones who had names, and the ones who didn't.

speaker: Odda
content: I could have saved him... it's just hard to raise your weapon against your own kin.

speaker: Ascalon
content: Your father died in the chaos of the city. Have you ever thought about seeking vengeance for him?
Odda takes a deep breath.

raw: [name="Odda"]I hate the people who killed him, but vengeance doesn't change anything.
speaker: Odda
content: I hate the people who killed him, but vengeance doesn't change anything.

speaker: Ascalon
content: A classical idea. Rational, righteous, human.

speaker: Ascalon
content: What if your vendetta is with a cold-blooded deathmonger, with hands soaked in blood?

speaker: Ascalon
content: Would you say you kill for justice and your ideals, without a hint of hatred?

speaker: Odda
content: I... I'm not sure.

raw: [name="Odda"]Do you regret killing mercenaries who threaten Babel, Ascalon?
speaker: Odda
content: Do you regret killing mercenaries who threaten Babel, Ascalon?

content: Then I won't either.

raw: [name="Odda"]Even if it means I have to...
speaker: Odda
content: Even if it means I have to...

speaker: Odda

content: No, all Babelites are important to Her Highness.

speaker: Ascalon
content: Time to go back.
Rhodes Island of Babel, Kazdel

content: It had nothing to do with the Military Commission, and I'm not an informer for them.

content: You—

content: All good fighters.

speaker: Ace
content: If I ever get to mentor the young, I'll raise them to be that kind of fighter.

speaker: Ace
content: Selfless, honest, cautious about picking a side, but committed once they've made their choice.

content: Pah. How sentimental.

content: Do the Sarkaz hate outsiders in Babel that much?

content: Fools like you who would give your lives for Her Highness wouldn't understand.

content: Babel might be changing certain things, but it's meaningless. It's not fast enough, and its reach is not far enough.

content: A researcher? A military commander?

content: Even though the Doctor killed so many Sarkaz? The more people like that, the longer the war will drag on.
